mapper.insert: INSERT INTO material_type(code,name,enabled) VALUES(#{code},#{code},TRUE) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE code=VALUES(code)

INSERT INTO material_type(code,name,module_type,allowed_file_types,enabled) VALUES(#{code},#{name},#{module},'pdf',TRUE) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name=VALUES(name),module_type=COALESCE(module_type,VALUES(module_type)),allowed_file_types='pdf',enabled=TRUE
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM material WHERE project_id=#{project} AND material_type_code=#{code} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_no),0) FROM material_version WHERE material_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE material_version SET file_status='SUPERSEDED' WHERE material_id=#{id} AND file_status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT v.object_key,v.original_filename,v.content_type,v.size_bytes,m.project_id FROM material_version v JOIN material m ON m.id=v.material_id WHERE v.id=#{id} AND v.file_status<>'DELETED' FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM generated_document WHERE material_version_id=#{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_reservation_item i JOIN material_reservation r ON r.reservation_id=i.reservation_id WHERE i.material_version_id=#{id} AND r.status IN ('RESERVED','CONFIRMED')
mapper.update: UPDATE material_version SET file_status='DELETED' WHERE id=#{id}
